items.title: “A Cute Little LibGen Babysitter”: Music Publishers Sue Anthropic Founders Over Torrenting Spree
items.summary: Anthropic's bulk torrenting of pirated books from shadow libraries LibGen and Pirate Library Mirror continues to generate new lawsuits. A group of major publishers, including Sony Music and Warner Chappell, have sued the AI company and its co-founders, alleging that torrenting activity that resulted in a $1.5 billion s…

items.title: Latest Suno lawsuit accuses AI company of violating the publicity rights of musicians rather than infringing their copyrights
items.summary: Suno is facing another lawsuit from the music industry. But this time it’s not a copyright lawsuit. A group of musicians claim Suno has violated their US publicity rights by “encoding musicians’ identities into its AI model” and then “exploiting those identities by publicly using musicians’ names”

items.title: The Sony and Warner music publishers finally get round to suing Anthropic
items.summary: The Sony and Warner music publishing companies are the latest publishers to sue AI firm Anthropic for copyright infringement. They also name Anthropic founders Ben Mann and Dario Amodei as defendants, arguing they were personally involved in the illegal downloading of pirated sheet music and lyrics

items.title: Donald Trump’s DoJ says OpenAI should be able to do whatever it wants with copyright protected works
items.summary: The US Department Of Justice has intervened in a legal battle between the New York Times and OpenAI, arguing that AI training is ‘fair use’ under American copyright law. Whether or not AI training is fair use is at the centre of dozens of AI lawsuits, including those filed by the music industry

items.title: SOCAN sues AI music company Suno, alleging copyright infringement
Adult Film Producer Unmasks Prolific ‘John Doe’ Torrent Pirate as Meta Executive
items.summary: A routine John Doe lawsuit could become part of Strike 3 Holdings' $446 million AI training case against Meta. The adult film producer wants to link the two lawsuits, arguing that a Reality Labs executive downloaded nearly 20,000 files at his home for work purposes, not for personal use. Meta counters that the alleged…

items.title: Jason Isbell’s Suno lawsuit takes aim beyond AI copyright
Donald Trump’s administration just sided with OpenAI in a key ‘fair use’ case. Here’s what it means for music’s fight with Anthropic and Suno.
items.summary: It appears to be the first time Washington has intervened in any of the copyright cases now stacked up against AI companies Source

Udio Fires Back Against Supersized Sony Music Copyright Lawsuit

tip.title: Metadata incompleta es dinero que se queda en el limbo
tip.body: ISRC, ISWC, nombres legales completos y porcentajes correctos determinan a quién le pagan. Un solo campo mal escrito manda tus regalías a la bolsa de no identificados.

tip.title: Incomplete metadata means money left unclaimed
tip.body: ISRC, ISWC, full legal names and correct splits decide who gets paid. A single mistyped field sends your royalties into the unidentified pool.
